2026-10-20 (LIVE-1157). The instrument half is in: test/e2e/surfaces.ts declares editorTargetSurfaces (a Spotlight from PW_SPOTLIGHT_HANDLE, a Site from PW_SITE_SLUG), wired into the manual capture workflow. The original probe now passes, so it is chained with the axis work it never measured: defineBlock must declare a density property. The row stays open until density lands and the owner sets the two repo variables and runs the capture.

verify.note: Measures the instrument E3 lacks: EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE §7.1 says none of E3 four target surfaces (Spotlight, in-app profile, Space, Site) has a visual baseline. The probe reads the declared surface paths in test/e2e/surfaces.ts and requires a /spotlight and a /sites/ surface, the two with no baseline of any kind today. Fails on main; passes once the captures are declared. 2026-10-20 (LIVE-1157): the probe moved into scripts/check-e3.mjs. Its first half is the same surface read as before; its second half asks that defineBlock declares density, so the row measures the axis work and not only the instrument.
